plugin.description: Shows the time and the date on a key - as an analog clock face, as digits, or as a freely formatted date. Every action can use a different timezone.

AnalogClock.description: Draws an analog clock face with moving hands on the key. It updates itself and needs no press.

timezone.description: Timezone to show, as an IANA name. Left out it uses the computer's own timezone.

DigitalClock.description: Shows the current time as digits on the key. It updates itself and needs no press.

timezone.description: Timezone to show, as an IANA name. Left out it uses the computer's own timezone.

twenty-four-format.description: 24 hour clock. Set to false for a 12 hour clock, which also puts AM/PM below the time.

show-seconds.description: Show seconds as well. Without it the colon blinks once a second instead.

label-position.description: Which label row the time goes into. Move it to the top or bottom to keep the middle free for an icon.

Date.description: Shows the current date on the key, in a format you choose.

timezone.description: Timezone to use, as an IANA name. Left out it uses the computer's own timezone.

key.description: The date format, in Python strftime codes.

label-position.description: Which label row the date goes into.
